proposals.before: Cui, Deng, Wei, Wei, Li Cheng, Han, Lu, and Gao
proposals.after: Cui, Deng, Wei, Wei, Li, Han, Lu, and Gao
proposals.reason: Chinese title lists surnames only (李); idiomatic invents given name Cheng.

proposals.before: When rebel bands raided Jingyang, Zhang Xiu sacrificed in a shrine, slaughtered oxen, and feasted with loud shouting.
proposals.after: When rebel bands raided Jingyang, they rested in a shrine building, slaughtered oxen, and feasted with loud shouting.
proposals.reason: 休祠房 means rested at the shrine halls; 休 is not Zhang Xiu.

proposals.before: It happened rebel bands raided Jingyang; Xiu sacrificed in a shrine, pounded oxen and shouted drinking.
proposals.after: It happened rebel bands raided Jingyang; they rested in a shrine building, slaughtered oxen and shouted while drinking.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise treats 休 as a personal name.

proposals.before: Before long, Songzhou prefect Liu Dian rebelled.
proposals.after: Before long, Songzhou prefect Liu Zhan rebelled.
proposals.reason: Later units identify the same rebel as 展 (Zhan).

proposals.before: Wang Silun was at Taiyuan with granaries full and overflowing; he requested shipping half the stores to fill the capital.
proposals.after: Wang Sili was at Taiyuan with granaries full and overflowing; he requested shipping half the stores to fill the capital.
proposals.reason: 王思禮 is Wang Sili, not Silun.

proposals.before: Wang Silun was at Taiyuan; granaries full and overflowing; he requested shipping half to fill the capital.
proposals.after: Wang Sili was at Taiyuan; granaries full and overflowing; he requested shipping half to fill the capital.
proposals.reason: Same name error in the literal field.

proposals.before: The deputy commander Zang Jie and the judicial officer Dazi Gun quarreled in anger; Gun said, "We are fortunate to have no trouble now."
proposals.after: The deputy commander Zang Jie and the judicial officer Daxi Gou quarreled in anger; Gou said, "We are fortunate to have no trouble now."
proposals.reason: 達奚覯 is Daxi Gou, not Dazi Gun.

proposals.before: He flung his robe and left; that night he killed Gun with troops.
proposals.after: He flung his robe and left; that night he killed Gou with troops.

proposals.before: Li Cheng led troops intending to take Bian, camped at its north gate and dared not advance; when Liu He's army camped at the east gate, the rebel general Tian Huaizhen surrendered to him.
proposals.after: Li Cheng led troops intending to take Bian, camped at its north gate and dared not advance; when Liu Qia's army camped at the east gate, the rebel general Tian Huaizhen surrendered to him.
proposals.reason: 劉洽 is Liu Qia, not Liu He.

proposals.before: Liu He stationed troops on the border and sent envoys to instruct him to stop; Kening then restrained himself, yet the roads remained closed for half a month.
proposals.after: Liu Qia stationed troops on the border and sent envoys to instruct him to stop; Kening then restrained himself, yet the roads remained closed for half a month.
proposals.reason: Same 劉洽 / Liu Qia correction.

proposals.before: At first Shence commandant Tuoba Chenghuan was encamped opposite him; Congshi would visit his camp to drink and gamble, and Chenghuan often produced precious belts and curious objects to show off to him.
proposals.after: At first Shence commandant Tutu Chengcui was encamped opposite him; Congshi would visit his camp to drink and gamble, and Chengcui often produced precious belts and curious objects to show off to him.
proposals.reason: 吐突承璀 is Tutu Chengcui, not Tuoba Chenghuan.

proposals.before: In the Yuanhe era, as left Weiwu guard general he followed Tuoba Chenghuan to attack Wang Chengzong; many generals lost their armies, but Xiayu alone distinguished himself, and an edict stored the armor and weapons he captured in the Shence arsenal to honor him.
proposals.after: In the Yuanhe era, as left Weiwu guard general he followed Tutu Chengcui to attack Wang Chengzong; many generals lost their armies, but Xiayu alone distinguished himself, and an edict stored the armor and weapons he captured in the Shence arsenal to honor him.
proposals.reason: 吐突承璀 is Tutu Chengcui throughout.

proposals.before: He was nominally demoted to prefect of Guizhou.
proposals.after: By edict he was demoted to prefect of Guizhou.
proposals.reason: 詒貶 is corrupt for 詔貶 (demoted by edict).

proposals.before: He was falsely demoted to Prefect of Guizhou.
proposals.after: By edict he was demoted to Prefect of Guizhou.

proposals.before: Li Cheng was a native of Xiangping in Liaodong, a distant descendant of Duke Kuan of Kuanshan in the Sui dynasty.
proposals.after: Li Cheng was a native of Xiangping in Liaodong, a distant descendant of Duke Kuan of Pushan in the Sui dynasty.
proposals.reason: 蒲山 is Pushan, not Kuanshan.

proposals.after: Li Cheng was a native of Xiangping in Liaodong, a distant descendant of Duke Kuan of Pushan in the Sui dynasty.
proposals.reason: Same Pushan error in the literal field.

decisions.reason: Chinese 崔鄧魏衛李韓盧高 lists surnames only; 李 has no given name, so idiomatic Li Cheng invents Cheng and the proposed surname-only list is correct.
休祠房 means the rebels rested in the shrine halls; 休 is the verb ‘rest,’ not a person Zhang Xiu. Context (賊醉) confirms the rebels themselves were drinking there.
The literal likewise turns 休 into a name ‘Xiu’ and misreads 椎牛; ‘they rested… slaughtered oxen and shouted while drinking’ matches 休祠房，椎牛呼飲.
s0045’s 劉殿 is the same rebel whom s0046–s0047 name 展; English Liu Dian is wrong, and Liu Zhan restores the co-referent name.
王思禮 is Wang Sili (思禮); Silun is an unsupported reading, and the rest of the proposed idiomatic matches the Chinese.
The literal has the same Silun error for 王思禮; Wang Sili is the correct personal name and the remainder is unchanged.
達奚覯 is the compound surname Daxi plus given name Gou; Dazi Gun misreads both the surname and 覯, and the proposed dialogue attribution to Gou is correct.
是夜以兵殺覯 names the victim 覯 (Gou); continuing Gun from the prior misreading is wrong, and the proposed idiomatic corrects only that name.
劉洽 is Liu Qia (洽); Liu He invents an unsupported given name, and the proposed idiomatic corrects only that personal name.
s0105 again has 劉洽; Liu Qia matches 洽, and the rest of the proposed idiomatic is unchanged.
吐突承璀 is Tutu Chengcui, not Tuoba Chenghuan; the proposed idiomatic restores the correct surname and given name while leaving the rest intact.
隨吐突承璀 again names Tutu Chengcui; replacing Tuoba Chenghuan with Tutu Chengcui corrects only that error.
Chapter 詒貶 is a graphic corruption of 詔貶; an edition reading 詔貶歸州刺史 supports demotion by edict, not a ‘nominal’ demotion.
Literal ‘falsely’ follows corrupt 詒; the same external 詔貶歸州刺史 reading justifies ‘By edict he was demoted to Prefect of Guizhou.’
隋蒲山公寬 is Duke Kuan of Pushan (蒲山), not Kuanshan; the proposed idiomatic corrects only that place/title name.
The literal likewise has Kuanshan for 蒲山; Pushan matches the Chinese, and the rest of the proposed literal is unchanged.

claimRetractions.reason: Wang Silun exists only as the bad English reading of 王思禮; accepting r0005/r0006 restores Wang Sili (already claimed in c0088) and leaves no source support for Silun.
Dazi Gun exists only as the bad English spelling of 達奚覯; accepting r0007 restores Daxi Gou (already claimed in c0116) and leaves no source support for this personal-name.
Liu He exists only as the bad English reading of 劉洽; accepting r0009 restores Liu Qia (already claimed in c0186) and leaves no source support for He.
Tuoba Chenghuan exists only as the bad English reading of 吐突承璀; accepting r0011 restores Tutu Chengcui (already claimed in c0265) and leaves no source support for this personal-name.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0004 shows English Liu Dian came from local 殿, but the same rebel is 展 in s0046–s0047; the personal-name claim must read Liu Zhan / 劉展 while keeping id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
